exposure: elevated maternal serum alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) in the second trimester
free beta-human chorionic gonadotropin (free b-hCG) MoM
cohort: A cohort of 22,574 pregnant women who delivered at Hangzhou Women's Hospital between 2018 and 2020 and were screened for maternal serum AFP and free b-hCG in the second trimester.
finding: Elevated maternal serum AFP levels during the second trimester are correlated with and can monitor ischemic placental disease (IPD) including IUGR, PROM, and placenta previa, and are associated with a higher likelihood of delivering male fetuses and low birth weight infants.
